name: browser-use
headline: Claude Code notifications to ensure no missed
short_description: Claude Code Notifications ensures developers receive immediate alerts for Claude's responses. It integrates with terminal and desktop notification systems, supporting various alert methods. Ideal for operations teams managing Claude Code workflows.
author: dongzhenye

sections.overview:
Claude Code Notifications eliminates the need to constantly check if Claude has responded by delivering immediate alerts through your preferred notification method. The skill supports three tiers: a minimal terminal bell (one command setup), a recommended configuration with two carefully chosen system sounds for key events (task completion and input needed), and custom integrations for desktop notifications, webhooks, and advanced automations. It works across macOS, Linux, and Windows with automatic OS detection and one-line installation. Developers and operations teams using Claude Code CLI benefit from reduced context-switching, faster task completion, and better awareness of when Claude needs input or has finished work.
Receive audio alerts when Claude completes long-running tasks
Get notified immediately when Claude needs user input or clarification
Set up desktop notifications for Claude Code responses while working in other windows
Integrate Claude notifications with Slack, Discord, or webhooks for team workflows
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/dongzhenye/claude-code-notifications`
sections.usage:
```
Set up Claude Code Notifications for [COMPANY]'s development team. We need alerts for all Claude Code responses in our [INDUSTRY] projects. Configure notifications for both terminal and desktop systems. Include priority levels based on response urgency.
```
Copy

```
```markdown
# Claude Code Notifications Setup Complete

```

**Alert Type**: Critical
**Project**: [COMPANY] Payment Gateway
**Response**: "Security vulnerability detected in auth module. Immediate review required."

**Actions Taken**:
- Triggered terminal bell and desktop popup
- Sent email to security team
- Logged in system audit trail

**Next Steps**:
1. Review auth module code
2. Implement security patch
3. Test in staging environment
```
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
